mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS destination_id, dt.name AS destination_name, dt.short_description, di.image_url AS thumbnail_url, cc.region_name, pcc.region_name AS parent_region_name FROM destinations d JOIN destination_translations dt ON d.id = dt.destination_id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN destination_images di ON di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON d.region_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON cc.parent_id = pcc.id WHERE ( dt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dt.short_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dt.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cc.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pcc.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
